judged_text: The 'requires feed_polling_url' and 'requires embed_by_username' tests never stub feed_polling_enabled? to true, so execute short-circuits on the default-false feed_polling_enabled? and poll_feed is skipped before the clauses these tests claim to verify are ever evaluated. Both tests pass even if the feed_polling_url.present? or embed_by_username.present? clauses are deleted from Jobs::PollFeed#execute, giving false confidence that each setting independently gates the hourly job.

adjudication.rationale: In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" examples only stub feed_polling_url/embed_by_username to nil. Jobs::PollFeed#execute gates poll_feed behind `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?`. Since the site setting default for feed_polling_enabled is false (config/site_settings.yml), these tests will typically short-circuit on `feed_polling_enabled?` and never meaningfully test the other two clauses, so they can pass even if those conditions are removed. This is a real, diff-grounded test-quality issue rather than a production behavior defect.
